description: This file defines the LaunchWizardClient class in the Aws\LaunchWizard namespace, extending the AwsClient to provide an API client for interacting with AWS Launch Wizard service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving deployments and workloads, and managing tags.

classes.name: LaunchWizardClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Launch Wizard service, extending AwsClient to provide specialized methods.

methods.name: createDeployment
methods.description: Creates a new deployment in AWS Launch Wizard.

methods.name: createDeploymentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new deployment in AWS Launch Wizard.

methods.name: getDeployment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific deployment.

methods.name: getDeploymentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific deployment.

methods.name: getWorkloadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches details of a workload.

methods.name: getWorkloadDeploymentPattern
methods.description: Gets the deployment pattern for a workload.

methods.name: getWorkloadDeploymentPatternAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the deployment pattern for a workload.

methods.name: listDeploymentEvents
methods.description: Lists events associated with a deployment.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a given resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
